direction.camera: Guide attention with wood grain; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: lead from a material-sized crop to a crafted whole; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with crafted detail; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with human scale.
direction.lighting: warm workshop window; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: oiled wood and brushed brass; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around patient macro; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use wood grain,crafted detail,warm shadow,material honesty,patient macro,human scale as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
